archetypes.name: kv-contract
archetypes.rationale: The plan introduces new DRIFT_* KV outputs, removes LOOP_STATUS values, and changes the Step 0-pre KV count from 8 to 7 — a cross-file naming contract that a single typo can silently break.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan adds DRIFT_TRIGGER_FIRED, DRIFT_MULTIPLE, DRIFT_PLAN_RATIO, DRIFT_DIFF_RATIO, BASELINE_PLAN_LINES, BASELINE_DIFF_LINES to check-plan-size.sh output and consumes them in SKILL.md Step 2b.5; it also removes LOOP_STATUS values (converged, cap-hit, revision-failed, emit-plan-failed, optional-trailer-dedup-loss, plan-size-trigger, plan-validator-defects) from plan-review-loop.sh, run-step3-review.sh, and SKILL.md. Verify that every KV name and enum value is spelled identically across all producers (check-plan-size.sh, design-postplan-emit.sh, parse-design-argv.sh) and all consumers (SKILL.md, run-step3-review.sh, plan-review-loop.sh, test harnesses). Check that the plan's Step 0-pre count change (-ne 8 → -ne 7) is consistent with the exact number of KV lines parse-design-argv.sh will emit after MANUAL_REQUESTED removal — count both sides independently against the plan text. Also check whether run-step3-review.sh's LOOP_STATUS normalization switch/case explicitly handles every status in the post-removal enum, with no silent fall-through to an unhandled branch. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: removal-completeness
archetypes.rationale: The plan removes --manual/manual_gate_b/MANUAL_REQUESTED across ~12 files; missing even one cross-reference (doc, test, hook, env reader) leaves a dangling reference that silently misbehaves on the next operator invocation.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan removes --manual / -m / manual_gate_b / MANUAL_REQUESTED from parse-design-argv.sh, write-run-params.sh, design-init-runparams.sh, write-design-current-env.sh, SKILL.md, flags.md, and approval-gates.md, and deprecates LARCH_DESIGN_ROUND_CAP. For each removed construct, check whether the plan accounts for every file in the scope list that currently references it — pay special attention to whether design-init-runparams.sh's jq-merge for manual_gate_b is removed in sync with write-run-params.sh's field deletion, whether SKILL.md's Step 0a/0b writer block and Step 0-pre validation block are both updated (the plan mentions both but they are separate edits), and whether test harnesses for write-run-params.sh and test-step0b-router-flag-recovery.sh are updated to stop asserting the removed field/flag. Also verify the plan's claim that schema_version stays at 3 is justified given the field removal — check whether any reader performs strict schema validation that would reject the absent field. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
